title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཨ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 109)
shelf_note: Derge woodblock folio of a Madhyamaka-section commentary (citing Daśabhūmika and Yuktiṣaṣṭikā, four māras, then śīla among the perfections); belongs to the Derge Tengyur dbu ma section.

ocr_errors.problem: an editorial variant bracket (ཀྱིང་,ཀྱང་) is inserted into the transcription; the print shows only ཀྱང

ocr_errors.image: ཉོན་མོངས་པ་དང་དུ་མི་ལེན་ སྡིག་པ (as far as I can read)
ocr_errors.problem: ལེན 'adopt' read as ལས; both translations correctly render 'not adopting afflictions', so the sense survives

ocr_errors.image: probably འགྱོད་པའི་མེ་ ('fire of remorse'), which fits 'cools the mind'
ocr_errors.problem: vowel probably misread (མི for མེ); the glyph is hard to read at this resolution

tr_errors_A.english: each of those demons were to manifest as many demonic bodies as there are pores on their skin
tr_errors_A.problem: the source has bodies emanated FROM EACH PORE; A turns this into a count equal to the number of pores

tr_errors_A.english: the power of all the demons of the three realms is completely subdued. They are tamed by the "Great Vajra of the Meaning of Emptiness," which subdues those who need subduing
tr_errors_A.problem: the quotation is restructured: the subduing power is an attribute of the vajra, and 'those to be subdued' are the object of 'tames'; A splits it into separate claims and gives the vajra the wrong role
the obscure transliteration ལ་གྷ་ཉ is turned into a confident 'actual executioner' with no sign of doubt

tr_errors_A.english: one does not engage in non-virtue under the influence of afflictions
tr_errors_A.problem: two separate negations ('does not adopt afflictions, does not enter into wrongdoing') are merged into a causal clause that is not in the source
the sense is 'recite of their own accord' (spontaneously, through habituation); 'personal recitation' blurs it
the Sanskrit title is labelled 'original', but the page has only the Tibetan
list formatting imposed on continuous commentary prose

tr_errors_B.english: which is the destruction of entities <note>interpreting the phonetic transliteration la gha nya as Sanskrit laṅghana…</note>
tr_errors_B.problem: a conjectural reading, but it is openly flagged as an interpretation in the note

tr_errors_B.english: the power that completely subdues the power of all māras of the three realms
tr_errors_B.problem: the appositive is placed loosely after 'emptiness' so it reads somewhat awkwardly, but the structure is preserved

tr_errors_B.english: emanated as many demonic bodies from each pore
tr_errors_B.problem: 'as many' leaves out what the number is compared with (དེ་སྙེད, 'that many', i.e. as many as there are beings)

pages.prefer_reason: Neither has a serious error, but B keeps the pore image, the Daśabhūmika quotation structure and the two negations in the śīla definition, and flags its conjecture on ལ་གྷ་ཉ; A has four moderate distortions and imposes list formatting.

book_verdict: A faithful Derge folio with a sound transcription (one editorial variant bracket and one or two minor vowel misreads). Translation B is clearly the better English; A is readable but loosens several clauses.
